findings.motion: M11 Concur (House concurrence vote on HB 958, Election Law Changes)
findings.note: Voted aye on House concurrence for HB 958, which passed 62 to 47. The ratified text requires the State Board of Elections to create a process to remove voters flagged as possible non-citizens by a federal database, and allows cross-state data sharing to check voter registration records. The text does not set a photo ID or documentary proof of citizenship rule. The Governor vetoed the bill on 2026-08-17 (see bill page); the member list shows excused absence on the second-reading votes on 2026-06-30.

findings.motion: Third Reading, SB 921 Const. Am./Require Photo ID For All Voters (House roll call #810, 73 ayes, 45 noes)
findings.note: House third-reading vote on SB 921, a state constitutional amendment requiring photo ID for all voters. The roll call transcript lists David Willis among the ayes. The bill became SL 2024-58.
